**NVDA trading — February 2 through March 12, 2026 (28 trading sessions)**
[1]

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Start price (close before Feb 2) | $191.05 |
| End price (close Mar 12) | $183.05 |
| Total return | –4.19% |
| Session low | $172.84 (Feb 5) |
| Session high | $195.92 (Feb 25) |
| Average daily volume | ~139.3 M shares |
| Trading sessions | 28 |

**Daily adjusted-close series** (excerpt):
Feb 2 $185.62 → Feb 5 $172.84 (low) → Feb 25 $195.92 (high) → Mar 12 $183.05.
Volume peaked at 266 M on Feb 26 and 227 M on Feb 27; otherwise ranged roughly 100–170 M shares.

---

**NVDA 8‑K filings in the same window (Feb 2 – Mar 12, 2026)**
[2]

| Filing date (event date) | SEC filed date | Items reported | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Feb 25, 2026** | Feb 25, 2026 | 2.02, 9.01 | Quarterly earnings release for the quarter ended Jan 25, 2026. Press release (Exhibit 99.1) and CFO Commentary (Exhibit 99.2) furnished. |
| **Mar 2, 2026** | Mar 6, 2026 | 5.02, 9.01 | Adoption of the Fiscal Year 2027 Variable Compensation Plan by the Compensation Committee. |

No other NVIDIA 8‑Ks fall in the February 2 – March 12, 2026 period in the selected SEC filings source. (Earlier results in the search were from 2025 or January 2026.)
